Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1185
Claimant:
Rachael Roberts
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
12-18-24
Reported a sideswipe during a lane change on a multi-lane road. The claimant is represented by counsel, and all
further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
12-29-24
Obtained the police report and statements from two witnesses, both of whom describe the other vehicle drifting into
the claimant's lane. Photographs taken at the scene show contact along the passenger-side panels, and the other
driver's account matches the witnesses.
2-22-25
Inspected the claimed vehicle. The damage pattern is consistent with the described impact, and no earlier damage
has come to light in the repair history or prior claims. Confirmed the driver listed on the declarations page is the
person who was operating the vehicle at the time of loss.
5-20-25
Coverage was in force on the loss date, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy's effective
date. Claimant reports neck and back strain and has provided medical records; no prior treatment to those body
areas is documented.
5-21-25
Claimant's account has stayed the same across each recorded conversation, though it is still unclear from the
statements exactly where in the vehicle the claimant was seated at impact. Treatment has followed a typical course
and has been tapering as symptoms improve. Whether the injuries were caused by this collision has not yet been
determined.
7-21-25
Reviewed the file with counsel's office and requested updated treatment notes to confirm the current status of the
claimed injuries. Liability for the property damage appears clear, while the bodily injury component remains open
pending medical causation review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
